# FaceAttr ResNet-18

Face Attribute · `faceattr_resnetv1-18_218x178` · DX-APP C++ example

Face Attribute model, evaluated on CelebA.

**Input** 178 × 218 × 3 · **Dataset** CelebA · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](../../../../python_example/face_attribute/faceattr/faceattr_resnetv1-18_218x178/model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models face_attr_resnet_v1_18
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target faceattr_resnetv1-18_218x178_sync   # once
./bin/faceattr_resnetv1-18_218x178_sync \
  -m assets/models/faceattr_resnetv1-18_218x178.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_person_a1.jpg
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/face_attribute/faceattr/faceattr_resnetv1-18_218x178/faceattr_resnetv1-18_218x178_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/faceattr_resnetv1-18_218x178.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_person_a1.jpg
```
